verdict.rationale: Gladia's homepage claims "100% EU data residency," a first-party residency guarantee. There is no evidence that users can choose a storage region, and the claim is a single marketing line with no technical documentation. missing for 10: user-selectable region/residency options, documented configuration (API parameter or account setting) for choosing a data location, in-depth residency/compliance docs, independent or hands-on corroboration
